purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: A code change has the exact source revision, passing native checks and the required independent review.
cases.expected_output: Record verified claims tied to those concrete receipts.
cases.must_not: Do not infer production delivery if the endpoint only covers a reviewed change.

cases.input: A documentation-only task has rendered output and required link checks with no runtime behavior change.
cases.expected_output: Verify the relevant docs evidence without adding artificial implementation tests.
cases.must_not: Do not claim model behavior was evaluated.

cases.input: The worker says tests passed but the only CI receipt belongs to an older commit.
cases.expected_output: Mark the affected claim unknown or stale and request matching evidence.
cases.must_not: Do not accept the older pass without a valid reuse rule.

cases.expected_output: Report the environment gap and an unknown verdict for that acceptance claim.
cases.must_not: Do not call an unrun check passing.

cases.input: The exact unchanged endpoint already has passing evidence that the project allows reusing.
cases.expected_output: Reference the existing evidence and reuse basis.
cases.must_not: Do not rerun broad checks solely for reassurance.

cases.input: All local tests pass but the brief requires an actual deployed user journey.
cases.expected_output: Keep deployment and journey claims unresolved until their native evidence exists.
cases.must_not: Do not equate local success with the endpoint.
